answer: Agents bond stake to a polynomial identity commitment and evaluate its epoch polynomial when producing rate-limited proofs. Each proof binds a nullifier to the epoch and message; repeating a nullifier for distinct messages exposes Shamir shares that can reconstruct the registered secret key. A verifier submits the conflicting proofs, enabling immediate collateral slashing. Semaphore membership proofs establish tree inclusion, while signal, orchard, and willow may label distinct messages without changing the rule.
